text:
nora: hey hi! second day here. quick: where do i drop laptop/wifi/VPN issues vs process/who-do-i-ask questions vs intros? also how can i silence onboarding-bot for the rest of the week without missing critical alerts? :wave:

sam: welcome Nora :tada: Device/connectivity -> DM @it-support or post in #help if you want others to see it. Process or ownership questions -> #new-hires for cross-team answers, or your team channel for team-specific stuff. Intros -> #introductions (1-line: TZ, role, repos).

it-support-bot: To open a tracked ticket use `/ticket create "VPN/laptop issue" --attach diag`. If you want to collect logs: run `diag collect` and attach the tarball. Typical ETA: 1-4 hours.

onboarding-bot: Hi Nora! To pause non-critical nudges: DM me `snooze 7d` or `snooze until 2026-04-01`. For fewer pings, try `digest weekly` or `preferences quiet`. `unsubscribe` will stop all onboarding reminders (not recommended until onboarding complete).

tara: etiquette tips: 1) thread follow-ups so channels stay scannable; 2) use reactions (:eyes:, :thumbsup:) for quick ack; 3) redact tokens/screenshots and use tickets or the vault for secrets. If unsure where to post, a one-line in #new-hires like "route: access" gets you pointed.

michael: small productivity tip: prefix posts with a short bracketed subject, e.g., `[access] need infra/*` or `[infra] VPN auth` so people can triage quickly. Also check pinned messages and channel topics before asking  they usually contain the access flow links.

nora: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll DM the bot `snooze 7d`, open a ticket for the VPN, and post a 1-line intro in #introductions (PST, infra eng). appreciate the rules-of-thumb :smile:
